children: Wolftank Group AG reported H1 2026 sales of €67.4M (+10.9% YoY) and EBITDA of €5.9M (vs €-2.6M), with EBIT €3.5M and net profit €1.3M. FY 2026 guidance of ~€135M sales and 6–7% EBITDA margin was confirmed.
